summary: El-Sayed called for an immediate Gaza ceasefire in February 2024 and later accused Israel of genocide, stating his criticism extends beyond Netanyahu. He holds a Vote for Peace 'Ally' rating, faced $20.1 million in United Democracy Project opposition spending, and is an owner-confirmed pro-Palestine Muslim community member. A Forward op-ed frames his vision as two-state self-determination, and a synagogue speech equated Hamas with the Israeli military—within his anti-war pattern, though the record shows no explicit BDS or anti-Zionist advocacy.
